title: Rock the Cradle, Joe
author: Ridge Kennedy
problems: Row 1 "balance & Rory O'More right past neighbors · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 1 "balance & Rory O'More right past neighbors · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 2 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 2 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Give & take: half the beats to cross, half to back home holding both hands.
